Title: Exit
Description: Close the console without running an operation.

Title: Prepare Endpoint
Description: Validate integrity, back up and install missing components.

Title: Local Audit
Description: Audit Windows, applications, certificates, hashes and produce reports.

Title: Dry Run
Description: Validate hashes and simulate preparation without changing Windows.

Title: Update Hash Catalog
Description: Manually recalculate SHA-256 entries for installer files.

Title: Validate Hashes
Description: Check installer paths and SHA-256 catalog integrity.

Title: Validate Only
Description: Run read-only structure, Windows, hash and pending checks.
